data_release: SPHEREx DR1 + QR3 (IRSA, as of 14 Nov 2026)

checks.headline: 5 of 5 test objects found where predicted, in 20 of 20 visits; median offset 0.191 px
checks.note: Recovered = a 5 sigma source (aperture S/N >= 5) within 2 px of the predicted position (Gaia DR3 moved to the visit's mid-time; published astrometry for WISE 0855) in a median stack of up to 5 photos (every photo for WISE 0855) of one visit and one expected detector. Saturated cores: Gaussian fit to the wings, or the centre of the masked core (scripts/validate/v1_targets.py, 41 px boxes read from NASA's S3 copy). WISE 0855-0714 (expected in D5-D6): found in 5 of 6 stacks, 3 of 3 visits; missed in visit 1 D6 (3 photos); also found in D1-D4, not counted (a background star lies 1-2 px from it). Rows: slug, recovered, visits, visits_recovered, stacks_expected, stacks_recovered, detectors, median_offset_px.

checks.headline: Barnard's Star moved 10.83" ± 0.36" at PA 357.8° in 0.986 yr; Gaia predicts 10.27" (+5.5%, 2.2°, 1.6 sigma); 5 of 5 targets within 3 sigma
checks.expected: Barnard's Star within 15% and 10 deg of Gaia (10.39"/yr)
checks.note: Shift = the target's position in the last visit stack minus the first, measured against reference stars in the same cutouts (site data <slug>/object.json, field measure); predicted = Gaia DR3 proper motion and parallax over the same dates (WISE 0855: published astrometry). dev_sigma = |shift - predicted| / sigma_arcsec. The pass rule is set on Barnard's Star; RW Aurigae and R Draconis barely move, so for them only dev_sigma means anything. 5 of 5 measured targets agree with the prediction within 3 sigma (largest: barnard at 1.6 sigma). Rows: slug, measured, shift_arcsec, predicted_arcsec, sigma_arcsec, dev_sigma, pa_deg, predicted_pa_deg, dt_yr, rate_arcsec_yr, n_ref_stars, shift_error_pct, pa_error_deg.

checks.headline: Position error 0.36" from 344 reference stars: motions above 1.1"/yr are seen at 3 sigma in one year
checks.expected: Floor ~0.25" (first photo); 10 or more reference stars
checks.note: sigma_arcsec is the scatter of the visit-to-visit shifts of quiet Gaia stars (G 13-17, under 20 mas/yr) in the same cutouts as the target; it is V2's error bar. The slowest motion visible at 3 sigma is 3 sigma / dt. The headline is Barnard's Star's field; across the 5 measured fields sigma runs 0.36-0.9" (fewer reference stars or a fainter target give a larger error). Rows: slug, sigma_arcsec, n_ref_stars, dt_yr, min_rate_3sigma_arcsec_yr.

checks.headline: Re-found 60 of 60 asteroids where NASA predicted them; median offset 0.125 px (0.77"); control 3' away: 0.7% of photos, 2 of 60 asteroids
checks.expected: N of 60; median offset under 1 px; control under 5%
checks.note: Asteroids numbered 1-60 at IRSA MOST's predicted position in up to 5 photos each (D2-D3, 81 px boxes read from NASA's S3 copy). Found = a 5 sigma detection within 2 px that is absent from a reference stack of the same sky 0.25-12 days away (nothing at 4 sigma within 3 px). Control = the same test 3' away. Per photo: 246/300 found, control 2/300; per asteroid control 2/60. Photos not counted mostly have a static star within 3 px in the reference stack, so a detection there can't be told apart. Rows: number, name, vmag_median, photos, found_photos, found, median_offset_px, control_photos, control_found.

checks.headline: Hunt zone: 434 of 457 known asteroid sessions at V < 16 found (as movers or recovered on a track) (95%); control 0%; 30 of 30 objects. Pilot zone (gate G2): 85 of 90 (94%), control 0%, 8 of 8 objects
checks.expected: Recall at V < 16 >= 50% (gate G2); control near 0
checks.note: Unit: one known object in one session with >= 2 exposures covering it. Known objects: Minor Planet Center orbits, propagated to each photo's MJD-AVG as seen from SPHEREx. One counts as found when a blind-search mover, or a dot recovered on a mover track's predicted path in that session, lies within 12" of its predicted position; control: every prediction moved 2'. Gate G2 is recall >= 50% at V < 16, decided on the pilot zone before the hunt ran. Objects brighter than V 12 saturate but are still counted. Hunt zone (RA 120.5-130.5, Dec +14.4 to +24.4, 3,692 photos): 2,628 photos with predictions, pipeline report of 2026-11-15T01:09:22Z; V 12-16 alone: 393 of 416; movers alone: 426 of 457 (93%). Pilot zone (RA 120.5-124.1, Dec +14.4 to +17.9, 990 photos; inside the hunt zone, so the hunt's numbers include it): 629 photos with predictions, pipeline report of 2026-11-15T01:30:39Z, MPC orbit snapshot mpcorb_2026-11-14.parquet + cometels_2026-11-14.parquet; V 12-16 alone: 67 of 72; movers alone: 84 of 90 (93%). Rows: zone, v_min, v_max, n, found, recall, control_recall.

checks.headline: 40 of 40 fastest Gaia stars measured: slope 0.943 +- 0.029 (measured against predicted shift), RMS 0.6"; 39 of 40 within 3 sigma; without the 6 blended with a brighter star, slope 0.972 +- 0.019
checks.expected: Slope near 1 (40 fastest Gaia stars with G > 12)
checks.note: Each object is measured exactly as V2 (server obj.measure, the code behind /api/object): its first and last visit stacks in one detector (the best S/N not saturated, from a 3-exposure-per-detector spectrum), at most 10 exposures per visit, on the 15' grid, with quiet Gaia stars as the frame and error floor (sigma_arcsec). Predicted = the Gaia model (proper motion and parallax) moved between the two stacks' median times. SPHEREx photos from SkyShift's whole-sky photo lists (IRSA's search was down; where no list reaches, the pipeline's index of every file on NASA's S3 copy), pixels from NASA's S3 copy, Gaia cones from the ARI Heidelberg mirror of gaiadr3.gaia_source (ESA's archive was down); list: GAVO DC TAP gcns.main (Gaia EDR3 within 100 pc), pmra^2 + pmdec^2 > 1e6 (G > 12.0, the 40 fastest); run 2026-11-15T11:41:00Z. Slope: a line through the origin fitted to both components (east, north) of every measured star, weights 1/sigma^2 (the status uses every measured star); RMS and median of the residual vectors |measured - predicted|: 0.6" and 0.37". Predicted shifts 1.032-5.145". Blends (blend_arcsec, from Gaia alone, before the measurement): a Gaia star at most 1 mag fainter in G within the measurement's 2 px (12.3") centroid search radius of the object at either stack time, which the centroid can lock onto: Gaia DR3 6165095738576250624 (G 16.2): G 14.0 at 7.32", measured 0.14" for 2.52"; Gaia DR3 470826482637310848 (G 12.3): G 9.7 at 11.23", measured 2.54" for 2.36"; Gaia DR3 4937000898856154624 (G 13.1): G 5.9 at 3.21", measured 3.27" for 2.25"; Gaia DR3 266846631637525120 (G 15.7): G 9.2 at 5.64", measured 1.64" for 2.03"; Gaia DR3 3554395813252626048 (G 15.4): G 10.3 at 6.62", measured 1.94" for 2.14"; Gaia DR3 1334160263982413696 (G 18.6): G 18.4 at 6.75", measured 1.82" for 1.96". Rows: name, source_id, g, abs_g, pm_mas_yr, ruwe, measured, reason, det, visits, dt_yr, shift_arcsec, predicted_arcsec, sigma_arcsec, pa_deg, predicted_pa_deg, angle_deg, dev_sigma, d_east_arcsec, d_north_arcsec, pred_east_arcsec, pred_north_arcsec, n_ref_stars, blend_arcsec, blend_g, search.

checks.headline: 8 of 10 brown dwarfs whose motion SPHEREx can show in one year (predicted shift >= 3 sigma) shift the predicted way; of all 24 measured, 23 agree with the predicted shift within 3 sigma
checks.expected: A count: brown dwarfs faster than 1"/yr shifting the predicted way
checks.note: Each object is measured exactly as V2 (server obj.measure, the code behind /api/object): its first and last visit stacks in one detector (the best S/N not saturated, from a 3-exposure-per-detector spectrum), at most 10 exposures per visit, on the 15' grid, with quiet Gaia stars as the frame and error floor (sigma_arcsec). Predicted = the Gaia model (proper motion and parallax) moved between the two stacks' median times. SPHEREx photos from SkyShift's whole-sky photo lists (IRSA's search was down; where no list reaches, the pipeline's index of every file on NASA's S3 copy), pixels from NASA's S3 copy, Gaia cones from the ARI Heidelberg mirror of gaiadr3.gaia_source (ESA's archive was down); list: GAVO DC TAP gcns.main (Gaia EDR3 within 100 pc), pmra^2 + pmdec^2 > 1e6 (pm > 1000 mas/yr, absolute G > 16.5, G - RP > 1.5, parallax / error > 10); run 2026-11-15T11:45:55Z. The list: Gaia's ultracool dwarfs faster than 1"/yr (the L dwarfs and fainter: at the star/brown-dwarf boundary and below) plus WISE 0855-0714 (published astrometry). The plan's Gagne list was not loaded (CDS is down). "The predicted way": the measured shift is at least 3 sigma and within 30 deg of the predicted one. Counted over the dwarfs whose predicted shift is at least 3 sigma (from Gaia's prediction and the error bar, not from the measurement). The other 14 are predicted to move 0.5-1.64" between the visits against an error of 0.42-0.93", which no measurement can show at 3 sigma. This rule was set on 15 Nov after the first run, which counted every measured dwarf: 9 of 24 shift the predicted way at 3 sigma by that count. Visible but not the predicted way: Gaia DR3 4996141155411984128: 4.91" for 1.64" +- 0.43", 73 deg off, detection S/N 4634 and 7956; Gaia DR3 6060561079334177664: 0.49" for 1.62" +- 0.49", 34 deg off, detection S/N 24 and 24. Blends (blend_arcsec, from Gaia alone, before the measurement): a Gaia star at most 1 mag fainter in G within the measurement's 2 px (12.3") centroid search radius of the object at either stack time, which the centroid can lock onto: Gaia DR3 1334160263982413696 (G 18.6): G 18.4 at 6.75", measured 1.82" for 1.96"; Gaia DR3 5372923621096443008 (G 19.1): G 18.1 at 5.9", measured 1.8" for 1.64"; Gaia DR3 930822015518055808 (G 20.7): G 17.2 at 7.51", measured 0.86" for 0.7"; Gaia DR3 2283612503305198208 (G 20.0): G 19.1 at 6.9", measured 1.58" for 1.11"; Gaia DR3 5278042880077383040 (G 20.0): G 17.2 at 4.85", measured 1.03" for 1.07"; Gaia DR3 309977380415042432 (G 17.6): G 18.5 at 7.33", measured 1.49" for 1.08"; Gaia DR3 5842772221276435968 (G 18.6): G 16.8 at 7.78", measured 0.56" for 1.02". Not measured: 1 not detected. Rows: name, source_id, g, abs_g, pm_mas_yr, ruwe, measured, reason, det, visits, dt_yr, shift_arcsec, predicted_arcsec, sigma_arcsec, pa_deg, predicted_pa_deg, angle_deg, dev_sigma, d_east_arcsec, d_north_arcsec, pred_east_arcsec, pred_north_arcsec, n_ref_stars, blend_arcsec, blend_g, search.

checks.headline: SPHEREx / catalogue flux, Ks 0.993 (scatter 2.9%, 25,696 stars); W1 1.029 (scatter 1.9%, 27,860 stars) (hunt zone, 10-13 mag; pilot zone Ks 0.993, W1 1.026); median time to first frame 7.9 s over 20 live requests (20 ok) (2026-11-14 13:54 UTC)
checks.expected: Spectra within 20% of 2MASS Ks / WISE W1; first frame under 15 s
checks.note: Spectra: every star of the zone matched one-to-one to Gaia, 2MASS and CatWISE, not saturated or variable; SPHEREx channels averaged over Ks 1.99-2.31 um and W1 2.80-3.80 um vs the catalogue magnitudes (zero points 666.7 and 309.54 Jy), no colour terms (scripts/validate/v8_spectra.py); fainter than 13 mag the scatter grows to 4.2-10.3%. Hunt zone (RA 120.5-130.5, Dec +14.4 to +24.4, 3,692 photos): Ks 0.993 (scatter 2.9%, 25,696 stars), W1 1.029 (scatter 1.9%, 27,860 stars) of 303,045 sources. Pilot zone (RA 120.5-124.1, Dec +14.4 to +17.9, 990 photos; inside the hunt zone, so the hunt's numbers include it): Ks 0.993 (scatter 2.9%, 3,918 stars), W1 1.026 (scatter 1.8%, 4,240 stars) of 45,189 sources. Speed measured 2026-11-14T13:54:11+00:00 against https://skyshift.web.app/api: 10 random coordinates (uniform on the sphere, seed 228060), each on both clocks, timed from the /api/frames request to the first frame received; a failed request counts as slower than any success. Median months 6.7 s. Median hours 8.7 s. 1 ok request(s) took over 15 s. The API was being sped up while this ran, so the number can change. For comparison, the 8 featured targets, served as static files, showed their first frame in 0.02-0.06 s. Rows: part=spectra (zone, band, mag_min, mag_max, n, median, scatter) or part=speed (ra, dec, clock, ok, first_frame_s).

checks.headline: 209,534 stars vs Gaia (hunt zone): proper-motion bias -4 (RA) and -0 (Dec) mas/yr, scatter 132 and 135 mas/yr; pull scatter 0.94, 0.94 (1 = honest error bars). Pilot zone: 32,093 stars, bias -3 (RA) and -1 (Dec) mas/yr, scatter 135 and 135 mas/yr, pull scatter 0.94, 0.94
checks.expected: Bias near zero; pull scatter near 1
checks.note: Proper motions fitted over all dots with SPHEREx's own position as the observer, against Gaia DR3. Zones: hunt zone (RA 120.5-130.5, Dec +14.4 to +24.4, 3,692 photos); pilot zone (RA 120.5-124.1, Dec +14.4 to +17.9, 990 photos; inside the hunt zone, so the hunt's numbers include it). Pass when both pull scatters are 0.7-1.5 in every zone. Rows: zone, axis, n, bias, scatter, pull_scatter (mas/yr).
